title: P10_TA(2025)0282 – Partial renewal of Members of the Court of Auditors - Daniel Caspary – European Parliament decision of 25 November 2025 on the nomination of Daniel Caspary as a Member of the Court of Auditors (C10-0269/2025 – 2025/0809(NLE)) (Consultation)

P10_TA(2025)0282
Partial renewal of Members of the Court of Auditors - Daniel Caspary
European Parliament decision of 25 November 2025 on the nomination of Daniel Caspary as a Member of the Court of Auditors (C10-0269/2025 – 2025/0809(NLE))
(Consultation)
(C/2026/1726)
The European Parliament,
—
having regard to Article 286(2) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, pursuant to which the Council consulted Parliament (C10-0269/2025),
—
having regard to Rule 133 of its Rules of Procedure,
—
having regard to the report of the Committee on Budgetary Control (A10-0238/2025),
A.
whereas, by letter of 24 October 2025, the Council consulted Parliament on the nomination of Daniel Caspary as a Member of the Court of Auditors;
B.
whereas Parliament’s Committee on Budgetary Control then proceeded to evaluate Daniel Caspary’s credentials, in particular in view of the requirements laid down in Article 286(1) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union; whereas in carrying out that evaluation, the Committee received a curriculum vitae from Daniel Caspary, as well as the replies to the written questionnaire that he had been sent;
C.
whereas the committee subsequently held a hearing with Daniel Caspary on 20 November 2025, at which he made an opening statement and then answered questions put by the members of the committee;
1.
Delivers a favourable opinion on the Council’s nomination of Daniel Caspary as a Member of the Court of Auditors;
2.
Instructs its President to forward this decision to the Council and, for information, the Court of Auditors, the other institutions of the European Union and the audit institutions of the Member States.
